overview.label: About us
overview.title: Who we are
overview.paragraph1: The Faculty of Computer and Data Science at Alexandria University specializes in computing, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. It was founded to meet demand for qualified graduates in digital fields.
overview.paragraph2: The faculty offers accredited academic programs, teaching labs, and staff with academic and industry experience. The aim is to prepare graduates who can work in local and international markets.
overview.imageAlt: Faculty of Computer and Data Science building

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: The faculty aims to provide strong teaching and research in computers and data science through modern academic programs that follow national and international quality standards, using up-to-date learning methods to prepare specialists who can compete in these fields.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Prepare specialized graduates for professional work in computers and data science through educational programs that follow national and international quality standards. Support a knowledge-based economy, help solve technical and information problems in society, and equip graduates so different labor market sectors can use modern technology and information systems in service of the community.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: Steady work toward clear quality standards in teaching and research.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: Room for new ideas and practical use of current technologies.

integrity.description: Ethical conduct and transparency in day-to-day work.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Working partnerships with academic and industry institutions.
